notes: Two taḥwīl branches meet at Abu Musa; the text writes Aisha once after them, so she is the shared tail
«ولا أعلمه إلا عن أبي بردة» is Hamid's own statement inside dashes naming Abu Burda: kept as the second branch's link
Aisha is asked by Abu Musa and answers, then quotes the Prophet: a link in her own place (rule 6)
«- وهذا حديثه -» and «- قال -» are glosses, left out
